title: The Week Forward Closed Its Clinics and Switched Off Its App
conflicts: Total funding: $657.5m (TechCrunch 2023, company count) and $650m (ICT&health) vs $400m (Maginative, Fierce headline); both given with sources. CarePods launched: 3 with one removed (ICT&health citing Business Insider) vs 5 in other Business Insider coverage seen only in snippets, against a plan of 25 then 3,200 (TechCrunch); story gives the readable figure, attributed. Closure date 12 vs 13 November; story says mid-November.
notes: Most closure coverage (Fierce Healthcare, Becker's, Modern Healthcare, Axios, Forbes, the More or Less podcast page) blocks the verifier, and businessinsider.com cannot be fetched, so Aoun's own explanation of the closure is not used; the story assigns no cause and states no feelings. Facts rest on Maginative, CBS News Chicago, TechCrunch, Fortune and ICT&health. Stance complicates (Ghazali: defining health is not being well).
